Title: 12.1 3Transformer-connections
Description: Learn the core connection configurations, including Star and Delta, for three-phase transformers, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 12.2 Parallel operation of two single phase transformers
Description: Learn the essential conditions, connection diagrams, and load-sharing principles for the parallel operation of two single-phase transformers, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 12.3 Transformer losses-OC
Description: Learn how to conduct an Open Circuit (OC) test to determine core losses and magnetizing current in a transformer, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 12.4 Cooling of tranformer
Description: Learn the different methods of transformer cooling, including natural air, oil immersion, and forced circulation, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 12.5 Winding a small transformer
Description: Learn the step-by-step process of calculated wire winding, insulation layering, and core assembly for a small transformer, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.
